senses.gloss: m. (אמן, ימן) prop. straight line, leader, hence (agric.) the border-bed, outmost furrow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:4">Ned. IV, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 41b:8">41ᵇ</cite>) <he>לא יעשה עמו בא׳</he> he must not work with him together in the border bed.—Pl. <he>אוֹמָנִיּוֹת</he>, [fr. <cite ref="A00710"><he>אוֹמָנִית</he></cite>, sub. <cite ref="P01317"><he>ערוגה</he></cite>, f.].
